items.name: use-debounced-value
items.title: useDebouncedValue
items.description: useDebouncedValue(value, ms = 250): the value once it has held still for ms milliseconds, so a search field stays instant while the request keyed on the debounced value waits for typing to settle.

items.name: use-paging
items.title: usePaging
items.description: usePaging(filters, initialSize = 50): zero-based page state for a paged table that returns to the first page whenever a filter value changes. Returns page, pageSize, offset, query (limit=…&offset=…), onPage and onPageSize; spread it into Pager.

items.name: use-url-state
items.title: useUrlState
items.description: useUrlState(key, fallback = "") keeps a string in the address bar's query, so filters, sort and paging survive a reload and can be shared as a link; useUrlListState(key) does the same for a comma-separated list. Writes replace the history entry, the fallback is left out of the URL, and every hook on the same key stays in sync. For apps whose router owns the query, use the router's API instead.
